propositions: Plan-review grounding finders flag symbols as missing/unverifiable even when a prerequisite ticket (via depends_on edge) will create them, violating the stated rule that depends_on symbols are treated as existing.

The [rebar:<id>] inline citation syntax must be parsed and verified against both upstream encodings: (a) the plan ticket's own depends_on edge to the cited ticket, or (b) the cited ticket's blocks edge back to the plan ticket.

Layer-1 deterministic advisory check verifies citations without blocking, mirroring det_operator_attested; any reverse-lookup error or edge-unbacked citation triggers an advisory coaching finding, never alters the verdict.

Layer-2 LLM coverage protocol uses show_ticket to judge whether a cited ticket's plan/file_impact actually establishes the specific missing functionality under evaluation; uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed symbols still fail closed.
Reverse-lookup exceptions (missing ticket, network error, store failure) are caught and treated as unverified citations, never propagating into the advisory lane.

Behavioral evaluation confirms Layer-2 protocol credits verified+covered citations (positive fixture: 5/5 samples) and withholds credit for edge-unbacked or coverage-absent citations (negative fixture: 5/5 samples), meeting >=80% threshold.
